Infinity-edge community pool

Lighthouse on 30A by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to your laid-back getaway near Topsail Hill Preserve. Lighthouse on 30A is a four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath retreat designed for easy mornings, salty afternoons, and quiet nights. Sip your coffee on the wide porches while the world wakes up around you. When adventure calls, hop on the golf cart for a quick ride to the beach, shops, and local restaurants. The first floor keeps things cozy with a guest room featuring two twin beds, connected by a Jack and Jill bath to another guest room with a queen bed. The third guest room, with a queen bed, has its own ensuite bath and a shady porch, ideal for naps and a good book. Up on the second floor, the open kitchen, dining, and living space is ready for waffle breakfasts, family game nights, and late-night movies, all flowing out to a spacious balcony for sunset chats. The third floor is all yours. The private primary suite with an ensuite bath, is perfect for catching up on sleep or enjoying a little peace and quiet above it all. At Lighthouse on 30A, days feel longer, laughter comes easier, and the whole place hums with good energy… 30A style! Oversee 30A is here to keep things smooth and simple.

Our local team is available seven days a week, with a 24/7 emergency line if you need us. Overview: - 1.2 miles to Stallworth and Highlands Beach Access - 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths - 2446 sq ft - Golf cart included - Parking for 3 vehicles - 4 Bikes - Large porches on first and second floors - Community infinity pool, fitness center, and pond access Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest Room: Queen bed, private bath - Guest Room: Queen bed, Jack and Jill bath - Guest Room: Two twin guest beds, Jack and Jill bath SECOND FLOOR - Half bath in 2nd floor hallway THIRD FLOOR - Primary Suite: King bed, private bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST
